posts.text: Our tiny team shipped release 3.16 after 24 days of testing. If anyone has a good dumplings recipe that does not need a stand mixer, please share. Small win: fixed a bug that has been haunting me for 90 weeks. Finally finished repotting 63 tomato seedlings on my balcony. Third attempt at tacos today and it actually worked. Hot take: Firefox error messages are better than most documentation. My parrot has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house.
